introMd: If you play +1 Blade Slayer, you know how important it is to get boosts that help you fight demons and upgrade your katana. Codes in this game give you free Magic, Emblems, Eggshells, and other items that make your character stronger. Using +1 Blade Slayer codes is a smart way to get extra resources without grinding too long. Let’s look at how to use these codes and what rewards you can expect.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem +1 Blade Slayer Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes in +1 Blade Slayer, so you can use them anytime to get rewards. Follow these steps:
1. Launch +1 Blade Slayer in Roblox.
2. Click the shopping cart icon on the left side of the screen to open the shop.
3. Select the Code tab inside the shop.
4. Enter the code exactly as it appears into the text box.
5. Press the Get Reward button to claim your items immediately.
rewardsMd:

Codes in +1 Blade Slayer mostly grant items that boost your character’s power and progression. Here are the common rewards and what they do:

| Reward Type         | Description                                                                 |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Magic               | Used to reroll your quirks, which change your character’s abilities.        |
| Emblems             | Help you ascend heroes to unlock stronger forms and skills.                 |
| Eggshells           | Currency to exchange for various rewards in the game.                       |
| Potions             | Restore health or provide buffs during fights.                             |
| Gold                | In-game currency to upgrade weapons and gear.                              |
| Premium Gems        | A rare currency used for special upgrades or items.                        |
| Phantom Pumpkin Boxes | Special event boxes containing unique items.                              |
| Flame Boxes          | Contain items that boost your combat stats temporarily.                    |
| Diamond Keys         | Used to open chests with valuable loot.                                   |

These rewards are unique to +1 Blade Slayer and help you customize and strengthen your character in different ways.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes may fail if you enter them with typos, so always copy and paste to avoid mistakes. Expired codes cannot be redeemed anymore, so check if the code is still active. There are no level or progress restrictions for redeeming codes in +1 Blade Slayer.
